speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. To narrow down the cause of your lesions, could you describe the specific appearance and texture of the rash (e.g., red, blistered, scaly, or bruise-like) and whether it has appeared on your palms or soles?

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pityriasis Rosea.
Based on the absence of fever, itching, and systemic symptoms, along with the typical presentation of multiple skin lesions, this is the most likely diagnosis.
REQUEST IMAGES: Close-up views of the trunk and proximal extremities to identify a "herald patch" or Christmas tree pattern.
